summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from Grupo Televisa, S.A.B., a foreign private issuer, reporting the filing of its annual Form 20-F and Annual Report with the SEC and Mexican authorities. It includes a press release and the annual report as exhibits. No transaction, activist event, strategic review, corporate action, or special situation is announced. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure of annual financial results and shareholder materials, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. It does not qualify as a special situation category.
